authority: Coordinator adoption under current pre-neural-score implementation authority; no neural scoring authorized
group_source: Pinned provider scripts/splits/data/pooled_image_groups.json; validate against pooled/per-subject duplicate groups and corrected random assignments
group_restriction: Preserve full provider component identity when removing excluded shared members; ungrouped unique IDs are singletons; never split a component across participants or folds
group_order: Descending maximum fraction of any participant-by-source cell occupied, then descending retained development group size, then lexicographically lowest retained image ID
assignment: Single deterministic greedy pass. Minimize increment in sum over five folds and fifteen cells of (assigned_count/cell_total - 1/5)^2; ties use smaller aggregate fold size then lower fold index. No restart or refinement
undefined_scores: not_evaluable; no epsilon clipping of constant RDM or perfect Fisher correlations
modal_planned_repeat_count: Unique maximum of intended-repeat histogram from source CSV where present or the documented source design where the unique-image CSV field is blank; never inferred from actual TSV counts

unique_repeat_design.source_quote: The remaining 4,712 unique images per subject are shown 4 times each
unique_repeat_design.csv_blank_handling: planned_repeats remains null; intended_repeats is separately sourced to the provider design

neural_validity: Not established by trial presence; later minimum-two-valid-presentations rule remains unchanged

trial_axis.source_beta_index: Preserved zero-based within-run index; require ordered contiguous indices per run and increasing run blocks in the provider 01-12 range
trial_axis.session_beta_axis_index: Original zero-based TSV row position, before any role filtering; addresses the session NIfTI volume / HDF5 betasmd column
trial_axis.documentation_discrepancy: The prose calls beta_index session-global, but the observed TSV restarts it per run. The documented row-to-volume correspondence and pinned loader's direct trial-mask indexing support the separate session row ordinal.
